title: Rice Pudding with Blueberries
excerpt: A comforting, creamy traditional Colombian dessert, renewed with the freshness and natural sweetness of our high-mountain blueberries. A treat for any moment.
imageAlt: Clay pot of creamy rice pudding topped with fresh blueberries and a cinnamon stick.

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons honey or sweetener, to taste

steps: Cook the rice in a pot with 2 cups of water over medium heat until the grains are soft and the water is almost fully absorbed.
Add the milk, the cinnamon stick and the lemon peel. Cook over low heat, stirring gently with a wooden spoon, for 20 minutes until creamy.
Remove the cinnamon stick and the lemon peel. Add the honey, the vanilla extract and half of the Fresh Pick blueberries.
Cook for 5 more minutes, stirring slowly so some of the blueberries release their purple juiciness into the rice.
Turn off the heat and let the pudding rest for 15 minutes before serving in small cups or dessert bowls, garnished with the remaining whole blueberries.
tips: Take advantage of the natural bloom of Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the cold mountains of Guasca, by serving them fresh over the warm rice for a pleasant contrast of temperature and texture.
If you want to enjoy it cold, keep the rice pudding in the fridge in an airtight container and add the fresh blueberries right when you serve it.
